envelope.streamId: random opaque UUID per local owner/consent generation; NOT derived from account/device/person; not freshness evidence
envelope.revision: positive safe integer, durably increasing within stream; full replacement, not patch
envelope.generatedAtEpochMs: original query epoch milliseconds; positive integer, not future; never receipt/render time
envelope.validUntilEpochMs: original source envelope deadline; no extension
envelope.metrics: object keyed by allowlisted metrics; each has state, optional integer value, validUntilEpochMs
envelope.kind: snapshot | revoked; revoked is value-free tombstone, metrics={}, validUntilEpochMs=0, no positive freshness window required; stream/revision fences still required

semantics: v2 initial scope only four source-proven metrics; no heart/HRV/narrative/derived labels without separately proven validity; no routine/operational changes

Missing metric is unavailable. Nonvalid states omit value and use validUntilEpochMs=0. States allowed: valid,no_data,expired,sample_time_unknown,revoked,permission_denied,invalid. Unknown state means unavailable.

Valid requires actual JSON finite integer within range, value present, both envelope and metric deadlines strictly greater than now, metric deadline<=envelope deadline, generatedAt<=now. No string coercion, fractional truncation or clamp. Zero valid is displayed as zero.

Malformed metric replaces that metric with unavailable/invalid while other independently valid metrics survive. Never retain prior value. Structural envelope/schema/control errors reject whole snapshot and clear CrewLife values, while preserving replay high-watermark.
Every accepted revision replaces entire snapshot. Expiry re-evaluated on load, open Activity, AOD/complication/render; no TTL renewal. Exact expiry unavailable '--'.
Reject unknown/prohibited envelope/metric fields recursively; no raw series, identity, account ID, location, tokens, labels or free text. Only transport stream nonce and revision allowed.

Source query TTL and per-sample provenance remain enforced at phone; Wire generatedAt is not proof of sample age. Phone must transport per-metric deadlines from sanitizer; cannot reconstruct from receipt.
handshake: Capability discovery is prerequisite only, never authorization, consent or cleanup proof. No capability/unknown peer => no v2 health values, remove phone-owned legacy health Data Items, report health unavailable.

Use node-directed MessageClient control/ACK. Control is {schemaVersion:2,op:reset,streamId,revision,requestId}; requestId random one-use challenge. No health data. ACK {schemaVersion:2,op:reset_ack,streamId,revision,requestId,status:cleared}. Validate source node against discovered intended peer and exact pending challenge; stale/foreign ACK ignored.

Wear reset first clears legacy CrewLife encrypted cache and current v2 values, persists stream/revision fence and v1 rejection policy, then ACKs. Reset retries same request id idempotently; stale/lower revision cannot roll back fence. New stream accepted only through current directed reset, not data arrival.

Before any values: local owner/consent fence captured; delete legacy phone Data Item; cleanup ACK required for each intended connected v2 node. Recheck generation/consent after every async step and before put. Consent alone cannot bypass pending cleanup.

DataClient items are shared/persistent, not node-targeted. Capability confirmed on one watch does not certify every paired watch or erase old watch cache. Offline/old watch cleanliness remains unconfirmed; keep unavailable/pending and no physical cleanup claim.

No app success from putDataItem/deleteDataItems means Wear applied it. Optional applied ACK uses exact stream/revision/requestId and status applied_unavailable/applied; means persistence/application only, never physical rendering proof.

Revocation control uses op=revoke with same stream/revision/requestId fields; ACK op=revoke_ack,status=cleared. Durable Data Item kind=revoked provides reconnect fallback. Reset ACK and revoke ACK are distinct and cannot substitute each other. Applied snapshot ACK op=snapshot_ack,status=applied or applied_unavailable never clears a pending revoke.
revocation: Owner change/logout, consent withdrawal, provider disconnect/empty/revoked summary immediately invalidate phone generation and cancel/ignore pending work; stop values before transport cleanup.

Advance persistent revision in current stream; send durable v2 unavailable/revoked tombstone full replacement with no values and retain until all intended v2 peers ACK cleanup. Delete legacy v1 health item. Do not delete tombstone before ACK; retry on reconnect/process restart with bounded backoff.

Reset/revoke ACK only after Wear health cache cleared durably and high-water fence persisted. Expired/replayed lower/equal conflicting revision cannot restore values. Regrant/new owner needs new opaque stream plus fresh reset ACK.

Routine is NOT deleted by CrewLife protocol migration or category-specific health invalidation. Existing explicit revoke-all routine behavior remains separate and must be tested, not silently changed.

Uninstall/reset/loss of sender journal or new node requires handshake again. Old phone+old watch remains unfixed; old phone+new watch v1 replay remains unavailable. Release remains blocked where legacy remote cache cleanup cannot be proved.

add: lower revision replay and duplicate idempotency
offline legacy cache not falsely confirmed
delete API success without Wear ACK
malformed full replacement cannot retain old metric

hold: HealthSync OFF; no SDK, new permissions, real health data or store action
MCC shared integration gate remains separate
implementationScope: Wear only; phone owner implements sender/capability and pending cleanup journal separately
